## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 6, 2026 - Jul 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Philip Davies_, Jul 26, 2026, 2/5: "I've been a paid Todoist user for years and it's so sad how they seem to have lost their way. The price has soared beyond its value, seemingly in the name of AI features I am not interested in. Worse, quality has suffered. The absolute core way I use Todoist is to regularly check the Today page and look at the count of outstanding tasks at the top. That count has been broken for months, getting stuck and failing to update. You couldn't find a much more basic feature and it's broken"
            2. _EstePerk_, Jul 3, 2026, 4/5: "I've enjoyed using Todoist. However, I think the recent update to the app has completely broken my widget? It wasn't updating to show my updated project, so I deleted the widget and put it back, and after putting it back the widget is entirely black. I'm on iOS 18.7.8, if it helps."
